3. Requirements for a quality-assured application
The requirements in the product information are to be taken into account. The Europe
Medicines Agency (EMA) provides the contents of the product information (summary
product characteristics, SmPC) for Keytruda (active ingredient: pembrolizumab) at t
following publicly accessible link (last access: 12 September 2024):
https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/keytruda-epar-product-
information_en.pdf
Treatment with pembrolizumab should only be initiated and monitored by specialists
internal medicine, haematology and oncology who are experienced in the treatment
patients with non-small cell lung carcinoma, as well as specialists in internal medicine a
pulmonology or specialists in pulmonary medicine and other doctors from specialist grou
participating in the Oncology Agreement.
In accordance with the EMA requirements regarding additional risk minimisation measure
the pharmaceutical company must provide training material that contains information f
medical professionals and patients. The training material contains, in particular, instructio
on the management of immune-mediated side effects potentially occurring wi
pembrolizumab as well as on infusion-related reactions.
